definitions.explanation: The main perpetrator of a crime who planned or led the criminal act. Distinguished from accomplices and accessories.

examples.japanese: {主犯|しゅはん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{主犯|しゅはん}{格|かく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指名|しめい}{手配|てはい}→指名手配：18897_shimeitehai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police issued a wanted notice for the man believed to be the ringleader.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主犯|しゅはん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逃亡|とうぼう}した→逃亡する：26871_toubousuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{共犯者|きょうはんしゃ}⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{名|めい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すでに⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The mastermind of the fraud case fled abroad, but three accomplices have already been arrested.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal and news term. {主犯|しゅはん}{格|かく} is a common variant meaning "believed to be the principal offender" or "ringleader-level figure," used when the exact role hasn't been legally established.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主犯|しゅはん}{格|かく} (ringleader; principal offender level)
- {主犯|しゅはん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}する→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧ (to arrest the principal offender)
- {主犯|しゅはん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{共犯|きょうはん}→共犯：11687_kyouhan⟧ (the principal and the accomplice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{共犯|きょうはん}→共犯：11687_kyouhan⟧: accomplice — a secondary participant in the crime
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧: criminal, perpetrator — the general word for someone who committed a crime
- ⟦{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}→首謀者：19171_shubousha⟧: mastermind — emphasizes the planning role
